s00-01-story-d35f4f.wav.text: Every nativity set has three kings kneeling at the manger.

s00-02-pivot-dd7eb1.wav.text: But Matthew never says there were three.

s00-03-story-d02066.wav.text: He never calls them kings. And they never saw the manger.

s01-01-story-f531b3.wav.text: Wise men from the east saw a star rise.

s01-02-story-3939d1.wav.text: They crossed hundreds of miles of desert to Jerusalem, and asked a dangerous question.

s01-03-grave-844814.wav.text: Where is he who has been born king of the Jews?

s01-04-grave-a2ebc6.wav.text: For we saw his star when it rose and have come to worship him.

s02-01-pivot-4a2cb7.wav.text: There was already a king of the Jews.

s02-03-grave-c6ae52.wav.text: When Herod the king heard this, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

s02-04-story-3dbdb9.wav.text: His scholars found the answer in the prophets. Bethlehem.

s02-05-story-976dbe.wav.text: So Herod sent the wise men there, and asked them to come back and tell him, so he could worship the child too.

s03-02-grave-2d9aba.wav.text: the star that they had seen when it rose went before them until it came to rest over the place where the child was.

s03-03-grave-781da7.wav.text: When they saw the star, they rejoiced exceedingly with great joy.

s04-01-grave-4daeb9.wav.text: And going into the house, they saw the child with Mary his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him.

s05-01-grave-808005.wav.text: And being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they departed to their own country by another way.

s06-01-talk-4c04ca.wav.text: Herod had a throne, and he was terrified of losing it.

s06-02-story-bfb282.wav.text: The wise men had treasure, and they travelled for months to give it away.
